LanguageData.LP_FallenCloudKeep.label: fallen cloud castle
LanguageData.LP_FallenCloudKeep.description:
The anchor chain of the cloud castle has snapped. Before the castle sank into the earth, a cloud giant escaped with three servants, a chest of silver and a few beloved artworks.

No weapons, only money, dignity and a silver tongue; Faerûn's pioneer league has long traded with the cloud castle (goodwill +40).

Cloud giants are particular about bedrooms, so build them a room befitting their status as soon as possible.

LanguageData.LP_FallenCloudKeep.scenario.parts.Config: One cloud giant and three human servants.
LanguageData.LP_FallenCloudKeep.scenario.parts.GameSt:
The snapping of the anchor chain sounded like thunder.

You only had time to grab the money chest and two favorite statues and jump from the sinking cloud castle with three servants. Now you stand in the mud, surrounded by strange wilderness.

No swords, no guards. But cloud giants never relied on swords: they rely on dignity, gifts and a tongue that can move anyone.
LanguageData.LP_FallenCloudKeep.scenario.summary: A cloud giant and three human servants with silver, gold and art, but no weapons.
